title: Prepared Clay
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 119
medium: Interactive page (index.html): twelve still works about Kyoto's 838 recorded days of full cherry blossom (812-2026), each by a fresh maker given the same brief and the material in one of three preparations (a table, sentences, the plain scatter plot). The visitor guesses each maker's preparation before the reveal. A figure (figure.svg); a reproducibility and git-order verifier (verify.py).
embodies: Finding a form, with the material's preparation as the one variable. Every maker turned what it was given into a table first, even a picture, which two of them read back to the exact values. Makers given numbers in any wording made the obvious scatter plot. Makers given the scatter plot as their material all left it. The preparation reached the form by subtraction: a form handed over as matter counted as already made.
project_step: Fifteenth experiment of the project. Operation: finding a form (with perceiving and choosing material). Takes up experiment 14's open thread 3 (the mould on a list: what in a brief or a material lets this family not make the obvious form?), and experiment 12's finding that showing the mould moves makers off it, now with the mould given as the material instead of shown beside it. Keeps the fresh makers and blind coder of experiments 10-14. Works with and against Iteration, not Imitation §4 K10 (Simondon's hylomorphic schema, MEOT 248-249: the clay is prepared) and Cartography, not Tracing (map and tracing, ATP 12-13).
material: Kyoto full-flowering dates of Prunus jamasakura, 812-2026, 838 values, compiled by Y. Aono and G. Katata, via Our World in Data (CC BY 4.0), fetched 2026-10-10; domain: plant phenology / historical climate records
seed: prepare.py seed 119 (arms); mask.py seed 1191 (coder order); build.py seed 1192 (face order); makers and coder are model instances and not seeded
